insight: Among the first community MCP directories; now lists 19,000+ servers, one of the largest registries.
name: mcp.so
tagline: Community directory for discovering Model Context Protocol servers.
description: mcp.so is a community-driven directory that collects and organizes third-party MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers so developers can browse, share, and integrate external tools for AI apps. It ranks servers by real call volume with a "Call Ranking" leaderboard and offers Featured, Latest, Official, and Hosted filters. The project is open-source and still in preview.

modelSupport.notes: A discovery/registry layer, not an LLM app.

edge: Ranks servers by real call volume via a "Call Ranking" leaderboard — discovery by actual usage, not just listings.
